---
title: "`r params$title`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: false
    number_sections: true
    self_contained: true
params:
  rating: NULL
  assessment: NULL
  title: "Rating report"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, comment = NA, results = "asis")
library(data.table)
rating <- params$rating
assessment <- params$assessment
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
got <- function(expr) tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) NULL)
tbl <- function(x, ...) {
  if (is.null(x) || !nrow(x)) { cat("Nothing to show.\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  x <- as.data.table(copy(x))
  for (j in names(x)) {
    v <- x[[j]]
    x[[j]] <- if (is.numeric(v)) {
      vapply(v, function(e) if (is.na(e)) "" else format(signif(e, 5), trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE), "")
    } else { v <- as.character(v); v[is.na(v)] <- ""; v }
  }
  print(knitr::kable(x, align = "l", ...))
}

has_fit <- !inherits(rating, "reach.rate::FlodeRatingTable")
prov <- got(reach.rate::rating_provenance(rating))
guided <- prov$fit_rating
```

# Read this first

This report describes a rating. It does not approve it. The lifecycle below is
recorded as it stands, and moving a rating from draft to approved is a decision
for a person. Every figure and table here is read from the stored rating and
assessment; nothing was refitted to make it.

```{r status}
conv <- if (has_fit) got(rating@limbs$converged) else NULL
st <- data.table(
  Item = c("Lifecycle", "Fit origin", "Schema version", "reach.rate version used to make it",
           "reach.rate version making this report", "Assessment overall"),
  Value = c(
    got(rating@lifecycle) %||% "not recorded",
    got(rating@fit_origin) %||% "not recorded",
    as.character(got(rating@schema_version) %||% "not recorded"),
    sub("^reach\\.rate ", "", as.character(prov$tool_version %||% "not recorded")),
    as.character(utils::packageVersion("reach.rate")),
    if (is.null(assessment)) "no assessment supplied" else reach.rate::assessment_status(assessment)
  )
)
tbl(st)
```

```{r lifecycle-log}
lg <- got(reach.rate::rating_lifecycle(rating))
if (!is.null(lg) && nrow(lg)) {
  cat("\nWho changed the lifecycle, oldest first:\n\n")
  tbl(lg[, .(When = format(at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC"), From = from, To = to, By = by, Why = reason)])
}
```

# The rating

```{r limbs}
tbl(reach.rate::rating_limbs(rating))
```

The equation for each limb is Q = C &times; (H &minus; a)<sup>n</sup>, with Q in
cubic metres per second and H in metres. See `vignette("mathematical_contract")`
for what is computed.

```{r breakpoints, results="asis"}
bp <- guided$breakpoints
if (!is.null(bp) && length(bp$stages)) {
  cat(sprintf("Breakpoints at %s m. Origin: %s. %s\n",
              paste(format(bp$stages, digits = 4), collapse = ", "),
              paste(unique(bp$origin), collapse = ", "),
              if (isTRUE(bp$advisory)) "They were suggested by the software and are advisory: they need review." else ""))
} else if (has_fit) {
  cat("One limb, so no breakpoints.\n")
}
```

```{r plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
print(reach.rate::autoplot(rating))
```

# The evidence

```{r evidence, results="asis"}
ev <- got(reach.rate::rating_evidence(rating))
if (is.null(ev)) {
  cat("This rating is an equation table and holds no gaugings, so there is no evidence to show.\n")
} else {
  total <- guided$n_evidence %||% nrow(ev)
  used <- guided$n_used %||% sum(ev$included, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("%d observations read; %d used in the fit; %d left out.\n\n", total, used, total - used))
  tbl(ev[, .(`Rows in the fit` = .N), by = .(`Source type` = source_type)])
  cat("\n")
  if (!is.null(guided$excluded) && nrow(guided$excluded)) {
    cat("Left out of the fit, and why:\n\n")
    tbl(guided$excluded[, intersect(c("evidence_id", "stage_m", "discharge_cms", "source_type", "reason"), names(guided$excluded)), with = FALSE])
  } else {
    cat("Every observation was used.\n")
  }
}
```

# The assessment

```{r assessment, results="asis"}
if (is.null(assessment)) {
  cat("No assessment was supplied. Run `assess_rating()` and pass it to `rating_report()`.\n")
} else {
  ck <- reach.rate::assessment_checks(assessment)
  cat(sprintf("%d checks: %d pass, %d warning, %d fail, %d not assessed.\n\n",
              nrow(ck), sum(ck$status == "pass"), sum(ck$status == "warning"),
              sum(ck$status == "fail"), sum(ck$status == "not_assessed")))
  open <- ck[status != "pass", .(Domain = domain, Check = check_id, Status = status, Finding = message, `What to look at` = recommendation)]
  if (nrow(open)) {
    cat("Everything that did not pass:\n\n")
    tbl(open)
  } else {
    cat("Every check passed.\n")
  }
  cat("\nThere is no overall score. A warning is a prompt to look, not a verdict, and a pass does not make a rating right.\n",
      "The limits behind these checks are best-endeavours defaults, not Environment Agency policy: see `vignette(\"thresholds\")`.\n",
      "The assessment does not record which limits were used; if they were changed, that should be written down alongside this report.\n", sep = "")
}
```

# What each stage range rests on

```{r support}
sup <- got(reach.rate::rating_support(rating))
if (!is.null(sup)) {
  sup <- copy(sup)
  nice <- function(v) vapply(v, function(e) if (is.na(e)) "" else if (abs(e) > 1e6) "no practical limit" else format(round(e, 4), trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE), "")
  sup[, `:=`(lower_stage_m = nice(lower_stage_m), upper_stage_m = nice(upper_stage_m))]
}
tbl(sup)
```

# How it was made

```{r provenance, results="asis"}
if (!is.null(guided)) {
  p <- data.table(
    Item = c("Call", "Model", "Objective", "Seed", "Observations", "Used"),
    Value = c(if (is.character(guided$call)) paste(guided$call, collapse = " ") else paste(deparse(guided$call), collapse = " "), as.character(guided$model),
              as.character(guided$objective), as.character(guided$seed %||% "none"),
              as.character(guided$n_evidence), as.character(guided$n_used))
  )
  tbl(p)
} else {
  cat("This rating was not made by `fit_rating()`, so it has no guided provenance record.\n")
}
```

What has been done to it since, in order:

```{r history}
tbl(got(reach.rate::rating_history(rating)))
```

# For the reviewer

Questions, not answers. This report cannot settle them.

- Do the gaugings cover the stage range the rating will be used over, and which
  parts are extrapolation?
- Is each warning above understood, and is the reason for accepting it written down?
- If the evidence includes anything that is not a gauging, is its source trusted?
- Were the assessment limits the right ones for this station, and were any changed?
- Is anything about the site, such as a weir, weed growth or a bypass, missing from the record?

# Reproducing this report

```r
imported <- reach.rate::import_rating("path/to/exported/folder")
reach.rate::rating_report(imported$rating, imported$assessment, path = "rating_report.html")
```

Made with R `r getRversion()` and reach.rate `r utils::packageVersion("reach.rate")`.
